project.name: MediRec
project.description: MediRec connects verified Canadian healthcare workers with facilities for shift staffing, with agency (partner) support. Built on React, Vite and Supabase, hosted on Vercel, with data in Canada (ca-central-1). This dashboard tracks progress and is auto-updated from the MediRec.ca WhatsApp group.

milestones.title: Migration plan + rollback checkpoint
milestones.detail: Written migration plan (schema, data, auth, storage, functions, secrets), hosting confirmation, tagged rollback release and procedure.

milestones.title: Migrate to ca-central-1 (Canada)
milestones.detail: All tables, auth users, storage and functions in the Canadian project; RLS verified; core flows passing.

milestones.title: Priority defects
milestones.detail: Commission timezone (done), facility signup role, role-based permissions, 'Account not configured', full-app refetch on tab switch.

milestones.title: Security review + handover
milestones.detail: Review SECURITY DEFINER views, written findings, handover, certificate of deletion.

milestones.title: Five-star reviews
milestones.detail: Facility and worker rate each other after a completed shift; public stars, private comments, Play-Store-style breakdown on profiles.

milestones.title: Profiles as full pages
milestones.detail: Worker and facility profiles open as clean, no-index pages instead of popups everywhere.

milestones.title: Designated-worker invite
milestones.detail: Admin and agency can send an open shift straight to a specific verified worker.

milestones.title: Final approval on matched worker
milestones.detail: Facility + agency approval gate built; workflow being adjusted to agency then MediRec final approval per client.

milestones.title: Admin tooling
milestones.detail: Create users with a chosen password, delete workers/facilities, and mark a worker verified from the dashboard.

achievements: Two-way five-star reviews with private comments and a rating breakdown on profiles.
Worker and facility profiles converted from popups to clean, no-index pages.
Designated-worker invite for admin and agency, with permission rules.
Final approval gate for matched shifts (facility + agency); workflow refinement in progress.
Admin can create a user with a set password, delete accounts, and verify a worker directly.
Table/card view toggles and mobile-responsive admin pages.
Automatic cleanup of stale, unfilled, past-dated shifts.
GitHub Action to auto-deploy database migrations and edge functions.
Fixed the '0 users' count, the Create User errors, and the invite button hang.

daily.summary: Shipped reviews, profiles-as-pages, the designated-worker invite, the final-approval gate, and admin verify/create/delete tooling. Set up a WhatsApp summarizer bot and this dashboard.
points: Reviews, profile pages, invite, and approval features pushed to main and deployed.
Admin can now create users with a chosen password, delete accounts, and mark verified.
Approval workflow to be adjusted to agency then MediRec, pending client confirmation.

daily.summary:
## Key points
* Asad encountered an error while trying to create an account and suggested improvements to the facility sign-up process.
* Asad and Hammad discussed the need for admin access, the ability to view shifts in different views, and the importance of tagging workers correctly.
* The conversation also covered the flow of shift approvals, with Asad and Hammad debating whether Medirec should be involved in the approval process.
* Hammad asked about the possibility of facilities using Medirec internally for scheduling and payroll.
* Asad and Hammad discussed the migration of the Supabase database from the US to Canada and the need to connect the new database to the website deployed on Vercel.
* Asad shared a Trello board to track progress and provided a link to join.

## Decisions
* Hammad decided to keep the current setup and not rebuild the app, instead opting to move the existing app to Vercel and continue making changes.
* Asad will rebrand the app visually to make important information clearer and more aligned.
* Hammad will make a small change in Lovable and publish it to test whether it breaks after the Canadian database is connected.

## Action items or open questions
* Asad needs to run a query to check if password hashes are present in the Supabase database.
* Hammad needs to provide the data to be dumped into the new Canadian database.
* Asad and Hammad need to discuss the cutover checklist, including the freeze window, syncing of worker uploads, and what happens to logins at switchover.
* Asad will list the 7 passwordless accounts and break down the 64 users by role to determine the real worker number.
* Hammad wants to prove that Lovable can still work normally against the Canadian database before proceeding further.

weekly.summary: Cleared the admin-tooling defects (Create User, 0-users count, deletes), added reviews and profile pages, and built the two agency features (designated invite and final approval). Set up auto-deploy and a WhatsApp summary bot.
points: Admin dashboard: create/verify/delete users, view toggles, mobile responsive.
Agency features built; approval workflow being finalized with the client.
